title: Advisers CLI JSON read models (contract v1)
description: Frozen v1 shapes for the deterministic, read-only CLI --json surfaces listed in commands-v1.json. Shapes are additive (backward compatible): new optional keys may appear, existing keys keep their meaning; required keys here must always be present. Errors are the separate ErrorEnvelope (stderr, exit 1). Status and exit codes are frozen separately in status-v1.json / exit-codes-v1.json.
x-source: docs/CLI-JSON.md + live CLI output at the freeze commit

SourceRef.description: One evidence/source reference. Source schema v2 plus legacy pointer shapes are both read; see docs/SOURCE-SCHEMA.md. The exact shape is owned by that document, not by this v1 freeze.

ResolvedEvidenceItem.description: One resolved/unverifiable/missing evidence row. Fields such as kind/type/ref/quote/quoteSha256/resolution/reason are documented in docs/SOURCE-SCHEMA.md; additive fields are allowed.

quoteVerified.description: 0.4.0 additive: true when the stored quote matched verbatim at build time.

dueAt.description: Original dueAt text, returned verbatim; may be absent.

Commitment.description: A ledger Commitment row (additive: new optional fields may appear).

id.description: Delivery id (del_* or template output id).
Commitment/calendar id, or the day id for all-day calendar items without a uid.

mcpProtocol.description: Neprotocol version: one of contracts/mcp/versions-v1.json supportedProtocolVersions.

ContractsDiscovery.description: Additive discovery field. Wired by the 0.3.0 integration wave (bin/ change); when present it must equal contracts/versions-v1.json discovery.expected.

model.description: Human-readable model mode label; never a key.

receivables.description: 0.4.0 additive: active receivable row count (never amounts).

payments.description: 0.4.0 additive: active payment row count (never amounts).

limit.description: 0.3.2 additive: per-group row cap requested with --limit.

truncated.description: 0.3.2 additive: true when any group had more rows than --limit.

dataSha256.description: SHA-256 of stable-stringified source data (deterministic for the same ledger/calendar day).

out.description: Written markdown path when --out is used.

notCheckedCount.description: 0.4.0 additive: entries with no local lookup capability.

fact.description: Fact row when the id is fact_*.

preference.description: Preference row when the id is pref_*.

notChecked.description: 0.4.0 additive: sources that could not be checked locally (neither resolved nor missing).

kbSources.description: 0.4.0 additive: explicit KB links for fact ids.

KbDocumentRow.description: One KB document row (sourceName is a basename; no absolute paths are exposed).

KbSkippedFile.description: Duplicate file skipped by a kb add batch (file is a basename).

SearchHit.description: One unified-search hit; highlights are numeric ranges into snippet, never HTML.

Fact.description: One fact row projection as returned by the 0.4.0 fact read views.

allOf.description: Fact plus the effective start instant selected at --at.

MailAccount.description: One mail account row; credentials never appear in this shape.

MailExtractCandidate.description: One mail extraction candidate (memory-candidate shape; dry-run previews carry no id/status).

Receivable.description: One receivable row: amounts are decimal strings mirrored by integer minor units.

Urgency.description: Deterministic urgency v1 attached to commitment items (derived at read time; never part of dataSha256).

SearchPayload.description: 0.4.0 additive: unified `search <q> --scope turns|kb|pages|all|facts --json` envelope (legacy unscoped search is unchanged).

KbAddPayload.description: 0.4.0 additive: `kb add --json` batch envelope (a single file is a batch of one; truncated/needsOcr are counts).

MailSyncPayload.description: 0.4.0 additive: `mail sync --json` result; when no account was named the payload carries a results[] array.

ReceivableAddPayload.description: 0.4.0 additive write payload: `receivable add --json` returns the library payload directly (no ok/command envelope).

ReceivableEditPayload.description: 0.4.0 additive write payload: `receivable edit --json` returns the library payload directly.

ReceivableVoidPayload.description: 0.4.0 additive write payload: `receivable void --json` returns the library payload directly.

PaymentAddPayload.description: 0.4.0 additive write payload: `payment add --json` returns the library payload directly.

PaymentVoidPayload.description: 0.4.0 additive write payload: `payment void --json` returns the library payload directly.

ClientExportPackPayload.description: 0.4.0 additive: `client export <id> --pack --json` client status pack v1 summary (no money fields).

x-documented-additive.note: Additive read models validated structurally (schemaRef/argv/metadata) by scripts/check-contracts.mjs --cli and never executed by the gate; each listed def carries accept+reject vectors in vectors/cli/read-models.vectors.json.
